# Six Figure Jobs
> Verified $100k+ jobs and six-figure career search

## About
Six Figure Jobs is a salary-focused job search engine for verified $100k+ jobs,
high paying roles, and six-figure opportunities across software engineering,
product, data, design, security, sales, operations, and leadership.

Jobs are sourced from company ATS feeds and trusted boards, then screened for
published salary ranges, freshness, seniority, duplicate listings, and direct
apply paths. Entry-level, internship, temporary, and low-salary listings are
filtered out of the main public feeds.

## Pages
- /jobs - Browse all $100k+ jobs
- /jobs/[role] - Verified $100k+ jobs by role
- /jobs/location/[country] - High paying jobs by country
- /remote - Remote $100k+ jobs
- /salary/[role] - Salary guides and role salary context
- /company/[slug] - Company profiles

## Structured Data
- Job detail pages use JobPosting JSON-LD.
- Listing pages use crawlable internal links and ItemList/CollectionPage context.
- Canonical pages avoid uncontrolled filter URL indexation.

## Best Query Matches
- six figure jobs
- 6 figure jobs
- $100k jobs
- high paying remote jobs
- software engineer $100k jobs
- product manager six figure jobs
- data scientist high paying jobs
